title: Descent of the coherent reduction/pullback adjunct equation
statement: Let the notation and hypotheses be as in the Lean declaration below. Descent of the coherent reduction/pullback adjunct equation holds.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 08TC and 0941; the representative/localization steps of the parent proof.

proof.text: Use the existing integralOperationsGoodLocalization_isLocalization theorem from IntegralOperationsWellDefined to identify the good-complex functor L with a localization at the inverse image of cochain quasi-isomorphisms.

Form the natural transformation b as pullComparison followed by the hom of pullbackTensorIntegralPullbackModel. Form c by whiskering the reduction/limit adjunction unit with ordinary pullback and then whiskering a.hom with coefficientSequenceLimit. Their source and target are the same functors, and the given hypothesis ha is precisely equality of their components on L(P).

Apply Mathlib Localization.natTrans_ext to L, its quasi-isomorphism class W and ha to obtain b = c. Evaluate this equality at the arbitrary derived object K. This proves the original component equation without any new representative calculation.

proof_origin.place: The localization descent step, implemented directly by Mathlib Localization.natTrans_ext and the existing good-representative localization theorem; V2, 2026-10-28.

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackReductionAugmentation_of_good {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (a : PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f ⋙
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction ≅
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).reduction ⋙ pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f)
    (ha : ∀ P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
      (pullComparison l E f).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫
          (pullbackTensorIntegralPullbackModel l E f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) =
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
            ((PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
          (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map
            (a.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E Y),
      (pullComparison l E f).app K ≫
          (pullbackTensorIntegralPullbackModel l E f).hom.app K =
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
            ((PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj K) ≫
          (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map (a.hom.app K)
